# Wise AI Blog

> Build type safe super agents blazingly fast with Rust

Wise AI is a research and engineering blog focused on building advanced AI systems in Rust. We cover topics including Large Mathematical Models (LMMs), autonomous agent architectures, symbolic regression, and type-safe systems programming.

## About

- Website: [https://wiseai.dev](https://wiseai.dev)
- Blog index: [https://wiseai.dev/blogs](https://wiseai.dev/blogs)

- Contact: oss@wiseai.dev
- Twitter: [@wiseaidev](https://x.com/wiseaidev) , resurrect my X account? Nah, this shit is slop.
